author: Anonymous
html: Hi Art, This is Ko+ from London. Thanks for your message concerning London Bomb Blast two weeks ago. Hope you have got my message via siit5 group email. I could not text you back (not sure why). This time (22 July) the incident was just 2 minutes walk to my office. Tottenham Court Rd and Euston Rd were closed and so i had to walk home to different direction.There are still many people from BBC and others around Warren Street Station near my office.I feel like bombing is a part of our lives in London now. Huh
